33602.meaning1: hard to control; difficult to arrest; tricky to pin down

examples.text: dunniggahassa lahuno, yatthakāmanipātino, cittassa damatho sādhu, cittaṃ dantaṃ sukh'āvahaṃ.
evaṃpakāraṃ asivaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ, ākāsagaṃ bhūmigatañ'ca ghoraṃ. anekarūpaṃ kira dunnimittaṃ, ahosi mār'āgamane samantā.
so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā. tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.

33606.meaning1: difficult to restrain; hard to hold back

examples.text: phandanaṃ capalaṃ cittaṃ, dūrakkhaṃ dunnivārayaṃ, ujuṃ karoti medhāvī, usukāro'va tejanaṃ.
dhanapālo nāma kuñjaro, kaṭukabhedano dunnivārayo, baddho kabaḷaṃ na bhuñjati, sumarati nāgavanassa kuñjaro.

gāmakathā'pi suniviṭṭha-dunniviṭṭha-subhikkha-dubbhikkh'ādi-vasena vā asukagāmavāsino sūrā samatthā'ti vā evaṃ assādavasena na vaṭṭati. sātthakaṃ pana katvā saddhā pasannā'ti vā khayavayaṃ gatā'ti vā vattuṃ vaṭṭati.

33608.meaning1: (vinaya) badly settled; wrongly closed; incorrectly put to rest

examples.text: punakammāya ukkoṭeyyā'ti, akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ punakātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabbaṃ'ti ukkoṭeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

33609.meaning1: (of meaning) obscure; not explicit; not clear
33609.commentary: (ANa) attho ca dunnīto'ti parivattetvā uppaṭipāṭiyā gahitā aṭṭhakathā.

examples.text: katame dve? dunnikkhittañ'ca padabyañjanaṃ attho ca dunnīto. dunnikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa attho'pi dunnayo hoti.
ayañ'ca me antaravāsako chiddo. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ aggaḷaṃ acchupeyyaṃ, samantato dupaṭṭaṃ bhavissati, majjhe ekacciyan'ti. atha kho so bhikkhu aggaḷaṃ acchupesi.
na hi nūn'imassa samaṇassa, tilākhettasmi pāpakā, ekapaṇṇā dupaṇṇā ca, ten'āyaṃ samaṇo sukhī.

33613.meaning1: with two sons; having two children

examples.text: na hi nūn'imassa samaṇassa, vidhavā satta dhītaro, ekaputtā duputtā ca, ten'āyaṃ samaṇo sukhī.

33614.meaning1: hard to give up; difficult to abandon

examples.text: lābh'āsā ca jīvit'āsā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve āsā duppajahā'ti.

33615.synonym: añña, apaṇḍita, appabuddhi, avicakkhaṇa, duppaññajātika, dummedha, dummedhī, bāla, bālavant, mūḷharūpa
33615.commentary: (MNa) duppaññā'ti nippaññānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. paññā pana duṭṭhā nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: yo ca vassasataṃ jīve, duppañño asamāhito, ek'āhaṃ jīvitaṃ seyyo, paññavantassa jhāyino.
paññavato ayaṃ dhammo n'āyaṃ dhammo duppaññassā'ti
atha v'āssa agārāni, aggi ḍahati pāvako, kāyassa bhedā duppañño, nirayaṃ so'papajjati.
duppañño duppañño'ti, āvuso, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, duppañño'ti vuccatī'ti? nappajānāti nappajānātī'ti kho, āvuso, tasmā duppañño'ti vuccati.

33617.meaning1: due to the defilement of being devoid of wisdom and a drooling idiot

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā duppaññā eḷamūgā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, duppaññaeḷamūgasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

33618.synonym: añña, apaṇḍita, appabuddhi, avicakkhaṇa, duppañña, dummedha, dummedhī, bāla, bālavant, mūḷharūpa

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, māgadhako gopālako duppaññajātiko, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye, asamavekkhitvā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimaṃ tīraṃ, asamavekkhitvā pārimaṃ tīraṃ, atitthen'eva gāvo patāresi uttaraṃ tīraṃ suvidehānaṃ.

33619.construction:
dur + pa + √ñā + a + tā
duppañña + tā

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… attanā ca appassuto hoti, parañ'ca appassute samādapeti, attanā ca kusīto hoti, parañ'ca kosajje samādapeti, attanā ca muṭṭhassati hoti, parañ'ca muṭṭhassacce samādapeti, attanā ca duppañño hoti, parañ'ca duppaññatāya samādapeti.

33620.construction:
dur + pa + √ñā + a + tta
duppañña + tta

examples.text: nīcakulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā nīcakulīnattaṃ upaneti, uccākulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā uccākulīnattaṃ upaneti, duppaññasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā duppaññattaṃ upaneti, mahāpaññasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahāpaññattaṃ upaneti. kammassakā, māṇava, sattā kammadāy'ādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammappaṭisaraṇā.

33621.meaning1: leading to being unintelligent; conducive to being stupid

examples.text: duppaññasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā na paripucchitā hoti, kiṃ, bhante, kusalaṃ, kiṃ akusalaṃ, kiṃ sāvajjaṃ, kiṃ anavajjaṃ, kiṃ sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ na sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ me karīyamānaṃ dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya hoti, kiṃ vā pana me karīyamānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya hotī'ti?

33624.meaning2: fact of being hard to cure

33625.meaning2: difficult to give up or abstain from

33626.meaning1: giving up with difficulty; not relinquishing quickly; not abandoning easily
33626.commentary: (MNa) yuttakāraṇaṃ disvā'va laddhiṃ paṭinissajjantī'ti paṭinissaggī, dukkhena kicchena kasirena bahum'pi kāraṇaṃ dassetvā na sakkā paṭinissaggaṃ kātun'ti duppaṭinissaggī

examples.text: att'ukkaṃsakaparavambhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, sandiṭṭhiparāmāsā ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, kuhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāp'icchā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāpamittā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgatā nigaṇṭhā'ti.
pare sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

33628.meaning1: hard to argue with; difficult to debate
33628.meaning2: hard to answer or refute; hard to argue with
33628.commentary: (MNa) duppaṭimantiyā'ti amhādisehi adhammavādīhi dukkhena paṭimantitabbā honti. dhammavādino nāma parājayo na sakkā kātun'ti dasseti.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, assalāyano māṇavo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo dhammavādī, dhammavādino ca pana duppaṭimantiyā bhavanti. n'āhaṃ sakkomi samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun'ti.

33629.meaning1: hard to penetrate; difficult to break through; (comm) difficult to see for oneself

examples.text: eko, āvuso, dhammo bahukāro, eko dhammo bhāvetabbo, eko dhammo pariññeyyo, eko dhammo pahātabbo, eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo, eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo, eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho, eko dhammo uppādetabbo, eko dhammo abhiññeyyo, eko dhammo sacchikātabbo.
katamo eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho? ānantariko cetosamādhi. ayaṃ eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho.

33630.meaning1: harder to penetrate; more difficult to break through
33630.construction:
dur + pati + √vidh + ya + tara
duppaṭivijjha + tara

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, duppaṭivijjhataraṃ paṭivijjhanti, ye idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhanti … ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhanti.

33631.meaning1: hard to get rid of; difficult to dispel; hard to remove
33631.commentary: (VINa) ime pañca duppaṭivinodayā'ti na supaṭivinodayā, upāyena pana kāraṇena anurūpāhi paccavekkhanā-anusāsan'ādīhi sakkā paṭivinodetun'ti attho. (ANa) duppaṭivinodayā'ti yāni hass'ādīni kiccāni nipphādetuṃ ṭhānāni uppannāni honti, tesu matthakaṃ asampattesu antarā'y'eva dunnīhārā duvikkhambhayā honti. (PYt) na suppaṭivinodayā'ti iminā dukkhena paṭivinodetabbā'ti duppaṭivinodayā, paṭivinodetuṃ na sukarā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: uppanno rāgo duppaṭivinodayo, uppanno doso duppaṭivinodayo, uppanno moho duppaṭivinodayo, uppannaṃ paṭibhānaṃ duppaṭivinodayaṃ, uppannaṃ gamikacittaṃ duppaṭivinodayaṃ. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca uppannā duppaṭivinodayā'ti.

33632.meaningLit: discourse on hard to get rid of

33633.meaning2: hard to dispel, get rid of

examples.text: yo so, gāmaṇi, assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tassa taṃ cittaṃ pubbe gahitaṃ dukkaṭaṃ duppaṇihitaṃ, ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā ahesuṃ iti vā'ti.

33635.meaning1: hard to split; tough to crack
33635.meaning2: hard to pierce, to tear apart

examples.text: oghapāso daḷhakhilo, pabbato duppadālayo, chetvā khilañ'ca pāsañ'ca, selaṃ bhetvāna dubbhidaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato jhāyī, mutto so mārabandhanā.

33636.meaning1: difficult to defeat; hard (for) to overcome
33636.commentary: (ANa) duppadhaṃsiyo'ti dummocāpayo, gahitaggahaṇaṃ vissajjāpetuṃ na sakkā'ti attho.

examples.text: durāsado duppasaho, gambhīro duppadhaṃsiyo, atho atthe anatthe ca, ubhayassa hoti kovido.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni app'itthikāni bahupurisāni tāni duppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi

33637.meaning1: difficult to ordain; hard to renounce
33637.construction:
dur + pa + √vaj > baj + yā + a
dur + pabbajjā + a

examples.text: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.

33638.meaning1: difficult to release; hard to get free from

examples.text: etaṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanam'āhu dhīrā, ohārinaṃ sithilaṃ duppamuñcaṃ, etam'pi chetvāna paribbajanti, anapekkhino kāmasukhaṃ pahāya.
icchānidānā bhavasātabaddhā, te duppamuñcā na hi aññamokkhā, pacchā pure vā'pi apekkhamānā, ime'va kāme purime'va jappaṃ.

33639.meaning1: difficult to measure; not easily measurable

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo anuddhato hoti anunnaḷo acapalo amukharo avikiṇṇavāco upaṭṭhitassati sampajāno samāhito ek'aggacitto saṃvut'indriyo. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo duppameyyo.

rājato vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti, corato vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti, aggito vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti, udakato vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti, nihitaṃ vā ṭhānā vigacchati, duppayuttā vā kamm'antā vipajjanti, kule vā kul'aṅgāro'ti uppajjati, yo te bhoge vikirati vidhamati viddhaṃseti, aniccatāye aṭṭhamī'ti.

kathaṃ te kāmā parihāyanti? tassa tiṭṭhantass'eva te bhoge rājāno vā haranti, corā vā haranti, aggi vā dahati, udakaṃ vā vahati, appiyā vā dāy'ādā haranti, nihitaṃ vā n'ādhigacchati, duppayuttā vā kamm'antā bhijjanti, kule vā kul'aṅgāro uppajjati, yo te bhoge vikirati vidhamati viddhaṃseti aniccatā'y'eva aṭṭhamī.
kuso yathā duggahito, hattham'ev'ānukantati, sāmaññaṃ dupparāmaṭṭhaṃ, nirayāy'upakaḍḍhati.

33642.meaning1: hard to fathom; difficult to comprehend
33642.meaning2: hard to go deeply into; hard to reach the bottom of, hard to fathom

examples.text: evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yena rūpe tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ rūpaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tāl'āvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ. rūpasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo.

evam'eva buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ akkhobhaṃ amitatejaṃ pabhinnañāṇaṃ vivaṭacakkhuṃ paññāpabhedakusalaṃ adhigatapaṭisambhidaṃ catuvesārajjappattaṃ suddh'ādhimuttaṃ setapaccattaṃ advayabhāṇiṃ tādiṃ tathāpaṭiññaṃ aparittaṃ mahantaṃ gambhīraṃ appameyyaṃ duppariyogāhaṃ pahūtaratanaṃ sāgarasamaṃ chaḷaṅg'upekkhāya samannāgataṃ atulaṃ vipulaṃ appameyyaṃ

33643.meaning1: hard to fathom; difficult to understand the depths of
33643.meaning2: hard to fathom; difficult to dive to the depths of
33643.construction: dur + pari + ava + √gāh + ta > gāḍha > gāḷha

examples.text: rūpasaṅkhāvimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.

33645.meaning1: difficult to overcome; hard to conquer

examples.text: durāsado duppasaho, gambhīro duppadhaṃsiyo, atho atthe anatthe ca, ubhayassa hoti kovido.

33646.meaning1: hard to overturn; not easily tipped over; difficult to knock over
33646.commentary: (SNa) suppavattiyo'ti suppavattaniyo. yathā icchit'icchitaṃ disaṃ pavattento dhāvati, evaṃ pavattetuṃ sakkā hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kumbho anādhāro suppavattiyo hoti, sādhāro duppavattiyo hoti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, cittaṃ anādhāraṃ suppavattiyaṃ hoti, sādhāraṃ duppavattiyaṃ hotī'ti.

33647.meaning1: badly taught; poorly explained; wrongly preached

examples.text: evarūpe kho, bhikkhave, dhammavinaye yo satthari pataṃ kissa hetu? evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite.

33648.construction: dur + pa + ā + √var > vur > pur > rup + ta

examples.text: so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā. tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.

33649.meaning2: difficult to fill up; hard to fill

examples.text: yadi duppūraṇ'aṭṭhena yadi vā samuddan'aṭṭhena samuddo, cakkhum'eva samuddo.

33650.meaning1: hard to support; difficult to maintain; high maintenance

examples.text: dupposaṃ katvā attānaṃ, gāme gāmaṇikā viya, bhutvā bhutvā nipajjanti, par'āgāresu mucchitā.

33651.meaning1: fact of being hard to support; fact of being difficult to maintain; fact of being high maintenance
33651.commentary: (VINa) yasmā hi asaṃvare ṭhitassa puggalassa attā dubbharatañ'c'eva dupposatañ'ca āpajjati, tasmā asaṃvaro dubbharatā, dupposatā'ti ca vuccati.

33654.meaning1: hard to talk to; obstinate; obdurate; stubborn; unamenable to verbal correction
33654.commentary: (VINa) dubbaco'ti dukkhena kicchena vaditabbo, na sakkā sukhena vattun'ti attho. (MNa) so ca hoti dubbaco'ti so ca dukkhena vattabbo hoti, vutto na sahati.

examples.text: bhikkhū pan'eva dubbacajātiko hotī'ti dubbaco hoti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti

33656.meaning1: of obstinate character; obdurate in nature
33656.commentary: (VIN 1.2.11) bhikkhū pan'eva dubbacajātiko hotī'ti dubbaco hoti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ. (VINa) dubbacajātiko'ti dubbacasabhāvo vattuṃ asakkuṇeyyo'ti attho.

examples.text: bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti

33657.meaning1: fact of being hard to talk to; obstinance; obdurateness; stubbornness
33657.construction:
dur + √vac > bac + a + tta
dubbaca + tta

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ dubbacanena vutto, tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ, atho pasattho'pi tatonimittaṃ, tuṭṭho na hessaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.

33659.meaning1: rule about being difficult to admonish; Saṅghādisesa 12

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ dubbaṇṇo assā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu? na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa vaṇṇavatāya nandati.
so ca hoti dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako bavh'ābādho kāṇo vā kuṇī vā khañjo vā pakkhahato vā, na lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.
nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya.
navaṃ pana bhikkhunā cīvaralābhena tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ ādātabbaṃ, nīlaṃ vā kaddamaṃ vā kāḷasāmaṃ vā.
antamaso kus'aggena'pi anādiyitvā tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ navaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

33663.meaning1: making one ugly; causing bad complexion

examples.text: acakkhusso, dubbaṇṇakaraṇo, dubbalakaraṇo, saṅgaṇikā-pavaḍḍhano, tiracchānakathā-pavattaniko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā aggismin'ti.

33665.meaning1: which disfigures; which makes one ugly

examples.text: dhī taṃ jammi jare atthu, dubbaṇṇakaraṇī jare, tāva manoramaṃ bimbaṃ, jarāya abhimadditaṃ.

tatra, bhikkhave, yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, so dīgh'āyukataro ca hoti vaṇṇavantataro ca mahesakkhataro ca. ye pana te sattā pacchā upapannā, te app'āyukatarā ca honti dubbaṇṇatarā ca appesakkhatarā ca.
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, navo ce'pi bhikkhu hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo. idam'assa dubbaṇṇatāya vadāmi. seyyathā'pi so, bhikkhave, potthako dubbaṇṇo tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.

dubbaṇṇasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā dubbaṇṇattaṃ upaneti, pāsādikasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā pāsādikattaṃ upaneti, appesakkhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appesakkhattaṃ upaneti, mahesakkhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahesakkhattaṃ upaneti

33669.meaning1: leading to being ugly; conducive to being unattractive

examples.text: dubbaṇṇasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patiṭṭhīyati kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

33670.commentary: (ITIa) kāye dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkamatī'ti pubbe paṭisandhito paṭṭhāya yath'ānubhāvaṃ ekayojanaṃ dviyojanaṃ yāva dvādasayojanamattam'pi padesaṃ ābhāya pharitvā vijjotamāno kāyo hoti khaṇḍiccapālicc'ādi-virahito, na sītaṃ na uṇhaṃ upaghātakaṃ, devadhītā soḷasavass'uddesikā viya hoti, devaputto vīsativass'uddesiko viya, taṃ khaṇaṃ'y'eva nippabhe nitteje kāye virūpabhāvo anupavisati saṇṭhāti.

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattam'pi me nacchādeyya, kāye'pi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya, kamm'antā'pi nappavatteyyuṃ, amittā'pi attamanā assu, mittā'pi dummanā assū'ti.

yadā, bhikkhave, devo devakāyā cavanadhammo hoti, pañcassa pubbanimittāni pātubhavanti, mālā milāyanti, vatthāni kilissanti, kacchehi sedā muccanti, kāye dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkamati, sake devo dev'āsane n'ābhiramatī'ti.
subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.
yo have balavā santo, dubbalassa titikkhati, tam'āhu paramaṃ khantiṃ, niccaṃ khamati dubbalo.
na h'ettha, bhikkhave, atthi dhammacariyā, samacariyā, kusalakiriyā, puññakiriyā. aññam'aññakhādikā ettha, bhikkhave, vattati dubbalakhādikā. taṃ kissa hetu?

33675.meaning2: (one) who is week, of little strength
33675.synonym: abala, abalaka, dubbala, dubbalathāmaka, dubbalī, hīnavīriya

examples.text: atha dubbalako puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imissā gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gacchissāmī'ti, so na sakkuṇeyya gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gantuṃ.
na h'ettha, bhikkhave, atthi dhammacariyā, samacariyā, kusalakiriyā, puññakiriyā. aññam'aññakhādikā ettha, bhikkhave, vattati dubbalakhādikā. taṃ kissa hetu?

33680.meaning1: little expectation of robes; weak possibility of robes
33680.commentary: (VIN 4.3.9) dubbalacīvarapaccāsā nāma sace mayaṃ sakkoma, dassāma karissāmā'ti vācā bhinnā hoti. (VINa) dubbalacīvarapaccāsāyā'ti dubbalāya cīvarapaccāsāya.

33681.commentary: (KVa) dubbalacīvarapaccāsāyā'ti dubbalāya cīvarapaccāsāya, sace sakkoma dassāmā'ti ettakamattaṃ sutvā uppāditāya āsāyā'ti attho.

33682.meaning1: perceiving there to be a low (expectation of) robes; regarding there to be a weak (possibility of) robes

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, balavā puriso dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ sīse vā gale vā khandhe vā gahetvā abhiniggaṇheyya abhinippīḷeyya abhisantāpeyya.

33688.meaning1: rule about a worn out (robe); Pācittiya 81

33689.construction:
dubbala > dubbali + karaṇa + ī
dubbalikaraṇa + ī
33689.commentary: (DNa) paññāya dubbalikaraṇī'ti sāgatattherassa viya kammassakatapaññaṃ dubbalaṃ karoti, tasmā paññāya dubbalikaraṇī'ti vuccati. maggapaññaṃ pana dubbalaṃ kātuṃ na sakkoti adhigatamaggānañ'hi sā antomukham'eva na pavisati.

examples.text: cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhān'ānuyoge. sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, kalahappavaḍḍhanī, rogānaṃ āyatanaṃ, akittisañjananī, kopīnanidaṃsanī, paññāya dubbalikaraṇī'tv'eva chaṭṭhaṃ padaṃ bhavati.
so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
kāmacchando, bhikkhave, āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso ajjhāruho paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo. byāpādo, bhikkhave, āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso ajjhāruho paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo.

33691.commentary: (ANa) dubbalīkaraṇe'ti yasmā ime pañca nīvaraṇā uppajjamānā anuppannāya lokiyalok'uttarāya paññāya uppajjituṃ na denti, uppannā'pi aṭṭha samāpattiyo pañca vā abhiññā ucchinditvā pātenti. tasmā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe kāye… vedanāsu… citte… dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
samaṇo, āvuso, gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, etha tumhe, bhikkhave, pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe satta bojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvethā'ti.

33693.meaning1: weakness; lack of strength; feebleness; incapability

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya, so yato yato sāyeyya, labheth'eva sādurasaṃ asecanakaṃ

33694.meaning1: disclosure of weakness; revealing one's incapability

examples.text: sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā'ti, atthi, bhikkhave, dubbaly'āvikammañ'c'eva hoti sikkhā ca apaccakkhātā, atthi, bhikkhave, dubbaly'āvikammañ'c'eva hoti sikkhā ca paccakkhātā.

33695.meaning1: weakness; lack of strength; feebleness; incapability

examples.text: atha dve bhikkhū āgaccheyyuṃ jighacchādubballaparetā.

33697.meaning1: hard to comprehend; difficult to understand

examples.text: gambhīraṃ bhāsasī vācaṃ, dubbijānaṃ sudubbudhaṃ, kassa tvaṃ dhammam'aññāya, vācaṃ bhāsasi īdisan'ti.
atha naṃ, idaṃ sītalaṃ bhavissatī'ti kaṭacchuṃ pūretvā ādāya āgacchantiṃ uttarāya dāsiyo disvā, apehi dubbinīte, na tvaṃ amhākaṃ ayyāya pakkuthitaṃ sappiṃ āsiñcituṃ anucchavikā'ti.

33699.meaning1: hard to drive away; difficult to dispel
33699.meaning2: hard to drive away or dispel

examples.text: jānāhi kho mahārāja, dukkhaṃ me dubbinodayaṃ, pahu samāno gajjasu, ekaṃ te duccajaṃ varaṃ.
